 the applicant.
Shri Ravendra Rajput-P.L. for the State.

Order 
This is second bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (439 of Cr.P.C.).

2.The applicant is in custody since 12.6.2024 in connection with Crime No.140/2024 registered at P.S.- Gandhi Nagar, Bhopal (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376(3), 363, 366-A,
450, 342, 506 of IPC and Sections 3/4 of POCSO Act.
3.Prosecution story, in brief, is that applicant repeatedly committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault on minor prosecutrix.

4. Learned senior counsel for the applicant submits that earlier bail application was dismissed as withdrawn and thereafter the prosecutix and her parents have been examined and they did not support the prosecution story.
Further, the DNA report has been received, which also does not support the prosecution story.
It is urged that the applicant is in custody since 12.6.2024.

Therefore,
it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:6171 2 MCRC-891-2025 pending the trial.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.
6.Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that the present applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8.This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9.Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately to appellant through concerned Jail Superintendent.
10.Certified copy as per rules.
